verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is an incorporation service, so this story's axis applies. However, its documented incorporation capability covers only German entities (UG, GmbH, holding structures) via notaries. Nothing in the evidence shows Delaware filing, bylaws generation, or initial board approvals.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals
